text_blocks.snippet: Coronary artery disease (CAD) symptoms can include chest pain or discomfort (angina), shortness of breath, fatigue, and pain or discomfort in the arms, shoulders, jaw, or back. These symptoms can be subtle and vary between individuals, with some experiencing more pronounced discomfort during physical activity or emotional stress. In some cases, CAD can lead to a heart attack, which is a more serious event with symptoms like chest pain, shortness of breath, and pain radiating to the arm, neck, or jaw.
